name: CTM Data Centre (Telecentro, Taipa)
developer: Companhia de Telecomunicações de Macau S.A.R.L. (CTM)
notes: Only Macao entity authorized to install/operate data centres under Reg. 13/2024 (CTT notice 2024-10-04: authorization granted to CTM; authorization No. 1/2024 renewed by Chief Executive Dispatch 180/2025 from 2025-10-01 to 2027-09-30). Macau Daily Times (2024-10-08): data centres to be established on floors 1/2/5 of CTM Telecentro Building, Rua de Lagos, Taipa. University of Macau on-site visit: first data centre in Macau with ISO 20000/27001/14001/22301 certifications (B-grade corroboration). DataCenterMap lists CTM Macau Data Center (Taipa, Rua de Lagos/Telecentro) as Macao's only directory facility (C-grade address). CTM also markets CTM (Hong Kong) Data Centre - HK-adjacent service, not a Macao facility. Capacity not published.

name: Macao SAR Government data centre / government cloud (SAFP)
developer: Macao SAR Government (SAFP - Public Administration and Civil Service Bureau)
notes: SAFP procurement pages show ongoing government IT/data-centre operations: continuation of 2026 Government Information Centre comprehensive information-system maintenance service, and 2019-12-05 purchase of data cold-backup/recovery solutions plus data-resource platform renovation services. Government infrastructure, not public colocation; tracked separately per MO methodology (government_cloud_or_data_centre). No public capacity figure.
